backend/main.mo: Main backend actor handling contact submissions, user profiles, access control, and content ingestion and auto‑publishing with a processed queue.
backend/post-helper.mo: Utility module defining post types and processing raw content into standardized ProcessedPost records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for many frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining color tokens, theming variables, and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document including required Google Search Console verification and mounting root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React Router setup defining all public and internal routes using SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/content/AccessDe: UI component showing an authorization error message with a link back to home.
frontend/src/components/content/FormStat: Displays a success or error banner with an icon and message based on form status.
frontend/src/components/content/UpdateCa: Renders an update preview card with image, category, date, title, excerpt, and navigation to the full post.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Provides the site footer with about info, quick links, state links, and legal navigation.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Defines the overall page layout with header, optional breadcrumbs, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Generates breadcrumb navigation based on the current URL path segments.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Mobil: Implements a mobile slide-out navigation menu with search, main links, state links, and footer links.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Displays the top navigation bar with logo, desktop links, search button, and mobile menu trigger.
frontend/src/content/seedUpdates.ts: Provides sample update items containing titles, categories, dates, excerpts, and detailed HTML bodies.
frontend/src/content/updateTypes.ts: Defines update categories, the UpdateItem interface, and a helper to map categories to display labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGuard.ts: Checks if the authenticated user is an admin using the actor and exposes authorization state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendPosts.ts: Fetches published posts or a single post from the backend using the actor and adapts them to frontend format.
frontend/src/hooks/useCombinedUpdates.ts: Combines backend posts with seed updates and provides filtering, sorting, and lookup helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading, login, logout, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides mutations for submitting contact forms and manually ingesting content, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom design tokens, dark mode variables, typography, and utility styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, services, commitments, and contact information sections.
frontend/src/pages/AdmitCardsPage.tsx: Displays admit‑card-related updates filtered by category with metadata and loading states.
Shows competitive exam info blocks and latest updates filtered by category with metadata.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, submission handling, and success/error banners. Uses a mutation to send form data and manages form state and errors.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Renders the site's disclaimer page with structured sections explaining information limits, verification guidance, and liability notes.
frontend/src/pages/EducationNewsPage.tsx: Fetches and displays education news updates, showing a loading state until updates load. Uses UpdateCard components to render each item.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Serves as the homepage, pulling latest updates across multiple categories and rendering hero content plus sectioned previews. Uses UpdateCard listings and navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Displays a 404 page with navigation options to return home or go back. Sets appropriate page metadata for missing pages.
frontend/src/pages/OwnerIngestPage.tsx: Admin-only content ingestion form allowing manual submission of new posts with validation, success/error banners, and backend mutation. Includes authorization guard and form state management.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Loads a post by ID from backend or fallback seed data, sets metadata, and renders a detailed article view with hero image and formatted date. Handles loading and missing-post states.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders the Privacy Policy page with structured sections and sets meta tags using usePageMeta.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx: Displays exam result updates using useCombinedUpdatesByCategory and shows a loading or grid of UpdateCards.
frontend/src/pages/SchemesPage.tsx: Shows government scheme updates by category and renders UpdateCards once data loads.
frontend/src/pages/ScholarshipsPage.tsx: Lists scholarship updates with state-based filtering and includes an application guide section.
frontend/src/pages/SchoolEducationPage.t: Provides school education info and displays categorized updates for classes 1–12.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Implements search functionality for updates, showing results or latest updates based on the query.
frontend/src/pages/StatePage.tsx: Displays state-specific updates by filtering all updates using state slug tags.
frontend/src/seo/usePageMeta.ts: React hook that sets the document title and description meta tag on mount/update.
frontend/src/utils/backendPostAdapters.t: Converts backend Post types into frontend UpdateItem objects and maps categories and timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/searchUpdates.ts: Provides query normalization and full‑text matching to filter updates, returning results sorted by newest date with stable ordering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending colors, layout, animations, and plugins such as typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, goals, constraints, and required features for an SEO‑preserving automated content‑publishing upgrade.
